title: Brittany's fishermen face battle to obtain fishing licenses
subhead: Though vital to their trade, licenses have become increasingly difficult to secure in the region. Local fishermen have criticized an opaque allocation system, while prices for second-hand boats have skyrocketed.

title: Tunisia, country of broken dreams: 'I wanted to photograph the young people whose lives began with the revolution'
subhead: Tunisian photographer Zied Ben Romdhane has documented his country since the fall of Ben Ali and the Arab Spring in late 2010. His work captures the deep malaise of a generation that has known only political turmoil and a lack of economic opportunities.

title: 'Changing your breasts is changing your life': How breast surgery can profoundly transform women
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (2/5). What if breast surgery changed both self-image and self-perception?
